title: SHMI: Soil Health Management Index R package (version 2.0.0)
description: R package implementing the calibrated Soil Health Management Index (SHMI), a 0-100 score of how closely a field's management record follows soil health principles (Cover/Roots, Diversity, Inverse Disturbance, plus an organic amendment bonus), calibrated against measured soil health on 354 US systems at 74 NAPESHM sites. Version numbers follow the published index: SHMI v1 is Deel et al. (2024); 2.0.0 is the calibrated score described in Moore and Manter (in review).
